authorization: User requested real repository issues and prospective intervention recording. Fixed scopes and evaluator definitions must be registered before starting comparison.

measurements.engineer_active_seconds: Sum of explicitly recorded human intervention intervals during each run. Automated controller work is recorded separately. No elapsed user reading time is inferred.
measurements.accepted_capability_seconds: Monotonic elapsed time from intent intake until independent evaluator and applicable canonical acceptance both finish. Failed or timed-out delivery remains unaccepted and retains censored duration.
measurements.cost_including_failures: Retain harness-reported costs where available. Codex API-equivalent cost is derived from reported usage and a pinned public rate card, labeled as an estimate rather than a subscription invoice. Missing usage stays unknown.
measurements.replanning_churn: Observed revisions to the authored scope/dependencies/proof after initial accepted plan.
measurements.integration_failures: Observed failures when accepted leaves compose under the integration evaluator.

fairness: Same snapshot, scope, evaluator, per-leaf execution rounds, timeout, model, tool permissions, and resource constraints within each scenario/harness.
Register the run schedule before execution and rotate workflow order across repeats.
Separate engine baseline invokes the pinned Seamwise source, with its real review/compile/materialization handoff.
Integrated uses native decomposition and the same TaskMesh lifecycle.
Native harness uses the same authorized scope and independent evaluator; it is allowed practical native planning and repair within the same budget.
Record all attempts and interventions. Never remove a losing run or backfill observations from remembered durations.
release_rule: All planned cells must complete and satisfy the original quality and productivity criteria; an unfavorable result remains a release gap.
interpretation_limits: The same supervisor-authored issue decomposition and independent evaluator are available to all arms. This measures delivery of understood issues; it does not evaluate architectural discovery.

Native harness retains a minimal HMAC authorization and canonical acceptance envelope, with direct harness execution and bounded experimental evaluation feedback. It does not use TaskMesh or the production managed-recipe runner.
Two harnesses execute concurrently per fixed workflow block. Their repository snapshots and daemons are isolated; host CPU and provider variability remain limitations.
Controller setup, inspection, and acceptance are automation, not a new human intervention. Zero observed human intervals do not measure the human effort that originally designed the corpus.
Reported release evidence identifies a source base commit and exact candidate artifact, explicitly disclosing uncommitted candidate changes. It does not establish a deployment.
supersedes_cohort_for_comparison: initial interrupted cohort; observations remain separately reported
cohort_rules: A new complete schedule is frozen only after the corrected workspace infrastructure is authorized and checked.
Keep the original issue snapshot, corpus, budgets, model pins, evaluators, and comparison criteria.
Retain the initial two observations and their cost separately; do not pool incomplete old cells into the corrected matched comparison.
Record PAUSE between blocks instead of killing the scheduler to prevent further dispatch.
No permission bypass flags or tool-denial retries without the applicable authorization.
